content.p: Let T:\mathbb R^{{n}}\to\mathbb R^{{m}} be the linear transformation given by T\left({{varvector}}\right)={{varmap}}.
Which of the following gives a basis for the kernel of T and a basis for the image of T?

outtro.p: Basis for \operatorname{Ker} T: {{kernel}}. Basis for \operatorname{Im} T: {{image}}.
